scripts.build: tsc -p examples/refund-agent/tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @eigen/core build && pnpm --filter @eigen/razorpay-adapter build && pnpm --filter @eigen/openai-adapter build && pnpm --filter @eigen/external-runner build && pnpm --filter @eigen/razorpay-smoke build && pnpm --filter @eigen/cli build && pnpm --filter @eigen/dashboard build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p examples/refund-agent/tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @eigen/core build && pnpm --filter @eigen/razorpay-adapter build && pnpm --filter @eigen/openai-adapter build && pnpm --filter @eigen/external-runner build && pnpm --filter @eigen/razorpay-smoke build && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/razorpay-adapter/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/openai-adapter/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/razorpay-smoke/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/external-runner/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/dashboard/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/dashboard/tsconfig.server.json --noEmit
scripts.test: tsc -p examples/refund-agent/tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @eigen/core build && pnpm --filter @eigen/razorpay-adapter build && pnpm --filter @eigen/openai-adapter build && pnpm --filter @eigen/external-runner build && pnpm --filter @eigen/razorpay-smoke build && vitest run
scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.compare-demo: pnpm build && node apps/cli/dist/index.js compare scenarios/refunds --baseline flawed-refund --candidate safe-refund
